variants.headline: Still in view: new settlers land from the ship
variants.sub: The ship in port has brought new settlers who landed at {district}.
variants.body:
New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

The gazette records the number of arrivals and the place where the settlers landed. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
